user.title: Set up Vimar View Cloud
user.description: Enter your MyVimar credentials (the same as the View app). In the next step you can choose the gateway or thermostat to add.

gateway.title: Choose the device
gateway.description: Your account has more than one gateway or thermostat. Choose the one to add; repeat the setup to add the others.

manual.title: Gateway DUID
manual.description: The gateway list could not be read from the cloud. Enter the DUID manually: in the Vimar View app go to Settings → System info, it is the BLEG code (format 000000AAA00000).

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Check your MyVimar email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Vimar cloud. Check your internet connection.

abort.all_configured: All gateways and thermostats on your account are already configured.

rebuild_energy_history.name: Rebuild energy history
rebuild_energy_history.description: Rebuilds the long-term statistics (Energy dashboard) of an integration kWh sensor from the power history: for each hour, kWh = mean power / 1000. Later hours are realigned without jumps.

entity_id.name: Energy sensor
entity_id.description: Integration kWh sensor to rebuild (e.g. sensor.oven_energy).

start.name: Start
start.description: First time to rebuild (rounded to the hour).

end.name: End
end.description: Rebuild up to this time (excluded). Empty: up to the last full hour.
